title: cyperus globosus var. nilagiricus
intro: Cyperus globosus var. nilagiricus, commonly known as Nilagiri Sedge, is a type of plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. The Nilagiri Sedge is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antidiabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Nilagiri Sedge contribute to its therapeutic actions, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine and potential future pharmaceutical applications.
